title: 第1036章 西域族第1035章 炼化胃液
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
炼化强腐蚀性胃液的十天里，李凡也一直用一心二用的特殊能力，感受外面的情况。
应该，外面的争斗一直没有停止。
神兽天龟的魂魄，也有过几次移动。
不过，移动范围不大，这说明外面的战斗，人类修士这边，恐怕依旧没什么进展，无法对这庞然大物形成威胁。
十天后，最后一滴强腐蚀性胃液都炼化干净。
李凡呢，这才收功。
“咦？”
李凡第一时间，发出一声惊奇的声音。
原来，不知道什么时候，小灵早已经跑出来，流着口水，在胃部空间里四下漂移。
什么意思？
李凡释放一块极品月亮石，这才看清楚。
在神兽天龟残魂胃部空间的最底层，竟然有无数各式各样的法器，法宝，还有古宝，以及一些李凡都不认识的宝物。
当然了，这些宝物都不知道在强腐蚀性胃液中放置多少岁月，几乎全部都彻底的损坏，变成废品。
废品？
没错，对于其他修士来说，这些宝物根本无法修复，没有一点价值。
可是，李凡呢，拥有神奇的大铁锅，这些废品都是宝啊！
“小灵，你在干什么，这些宝物都彻底报废了吧？”
李凡忍不住问道。
“不是，这些宝物都有天魂珠的气息，看起来，都挺好吃的。
可是，让我找出最好吃的一件宝物，我却感觉无从下嘴了。”

小灵用一只小手抓着头顶的小辫子，脑袋微微一歪。
“晕！”
李凡一阵头大，然后突然反应过来，“小灵，你是说，根本无法确定天魂珠这件异宝的准确位置？”
“嘻嘻。”
小灵呢，又露出古灵精怪的微笑，“大傻个，我发现，你现在越来越敏锐了。
根本不用我提示，你就可以抓住问题的重点。”
“不会吧，小灵，咱们费尽力气，最后找不到天魂珠？”
李凡有点无奈。
“嗯，大傻个，你这思想觉悟，有待提高哦！
看看，这么多宝物啊！
提醒一下，这里的宝物虽然大部分都废弃了，但是有一点，这可都是上古时期的宝物哦！”
小灵耐心的解释。
“上古时期？”
李凡沉思一下，“你的意思是，这神兽天龟残魂在上古时期就已经潜伏在如今天贵城的位置。”
“没错，不过，你的关注点怎么总是这么刁钻呢？”
小灵又是一歪脑袋。
小灵是在强调这里的宝物，而李凡呢，则是关注这个庞然大物的存在时间。
“嗯，怎么会这么巧，整个天贵城，就修建在神兽天龟残魂这个庞然大物之上呢？”
content_en:
During the ten days of refining the highly corrosive gastric juice, Li Fan had been using his special multitasking ability to sense the situation outside.
It should be that the fighting outside has never stopped.
The soul of the divine beast Sky Turtle has also moved several times.
However, the movement range is not large, which shows that in the battle outside, the human monks still have little progress and cannot pose a threat to this behemoth.
Ten days later, every last drop of highly corrosive gastric juice was refined.
As for Li Fan, he just finished his work.
"Huh?"
Li Fan immediately made a surprised sound.
It turned out that at some point, the little spirit had already run out, drooling, and drifting around in the stomach space.
What's the meaning?
Li Fan released a top-quality moon stone, and then he saw it clearly.
At the bottom of the stomach space of the remnant soul of the divine beast Sky Turtle, there were countless various magical weapons, magic weapons, ancient treasures, and some treasures that Li Fan didn't even recognize.
Of course, these treasures had been left in the highly corrosive gastric juice for who knows how many years, and almost all of them were completely damaged and turned into waste.
Scrap?
That's right, to other monks, these treasures cannot be repaired at all and have no value at all.
But, as for Li Fan, he has a magical big iron pot, and these scraps are all treasures!
"Xiao Ling, what are you doing? Are these treasures completely scrapped?"
Li Fan couldn't help but ask.
"No, these treasures all have the aura of Heavenly Soul Beads, and they all look quite delicious.
However, when I was asked to find the most delicious treasure, I felt that I had no choice but to put it down. "
Xiao Ling grabbed the braid on the top of her head with one small hand and tilted her head slightly.
"Dizzy!"
Li Fan felt dizzy for a while, and then suddenly realized, "Xiao Ling, are you saying that it's impossible to determine the exact location of the rare treasure, the Sky Soul Pearl?"
"Hehe."
As for Xiao Ling, he showed a weird smile again, "You idiot, I find that you are getting more and more sharp now.
You can get to the point of the question without any prompting from me. "
"No way, Xiao Ling, we tried our best but couldn't find the Heavenly Soul Pearl in the end?"
Li Fan was a little helpless.
"Well, you idiot, your ideological awareness needs to be improved!
Look, there are so many treasures!
As a reminder, although most of the treasures here are abandoned, there is one thing: these are all treasures from ancient times! "
Xiaoling explained patiently.
"Ancient times?"
Li Fan pondered for a moment, "You mean, the remnant soul of this divine beast, the turtle, has been lurking in the current location of Tiangui City since ancient times."
"Yes, but why are your focus always so tricky?"
Xiaoling tilted his head again.
Xiao Ling was emphasizing the treasures here, while Li Fan was paying attention to the existence time of this behemoth.
"Well, how could it be such a coincidence that the entire Tiangui City is built on the remnant soul of the divine beast Sky Turtle?"
